fullTextEN: If you want to be polite,

fullTextZH: 你可以跟他们说什么呢？
fullTextEN: What can you say to them?

fullTextZH: 他和他的家人在秘鲁开了一家中餐厅，
fullTextEN: He and his family opened a Chinese restaurant in Peru,
Because his Chinese is very good,

fullTextZH: 他的中国客人非常喜欢他。
fullTextEN: His Chinese guests like him very much.

fullTextZH: 有时候他们想他一起喝酒，
fullTextEN: Sometimes they want him to drink with them,

fullTextZH: 可是他发现中国人高兴的时候想喝很多很多酒，
fullTextEN: But he found that when Chinese people are happy, they want to drink a lot,

fullTextZH: 而且虽然他说我不能喝很多酒，
fullTextEN: And although he says I can't drink a lot,

fullTextZH: 但是他的客人会告诉他，
fullTextEN: But his guests will tell him,
This is called persuading to drink in Chinese.

fullTextZH: 劝酒的意思就是劝别人喝酒，
fullTextEN: Persuading to drink means persuading others to drink,
Persuade others to drink another glass,
Will they try to persuade you to drink?
If you want to be polite,

fullTextZH: 你可以跟他们说什么呢？
fullTextEN: What can you say to them?

fullTextZH: 今天我教你 4 个方法。
fullTextEN: Today I will teach you 4 methods.

fullTextZH: 你可以说因为我的身体，
fullTextEN: You can say because of my health,

fullTextZH: 比如说如果你的肚子很大，
fullTextEN: For example, if your belly is big,

fullTextZH: 那如果你的肚子不是很大，
fullTextEN: If your belly is not very big,

fullTextZH: 来大姨妈就是女孩子每个月都会有几天不太舒服，
fullTextEN: Having a period means girls feel uncomfortable for a few days each month,
Not very happy to have a period,

fullTextZH: 如果你真的不知道说什么，
fullTextEN: If you really don't know what to say,
But you don't want to drink anymore,

fullTextZH: 你的朋友还在说再喝一杯，
fullTextEN: Your friend is still saying to drink another glass,

fullTextZH: 你也可以说我对酒精过敏。
fullTextEN: You can also say I'm allergic to alcohol.

fullTextZH: 我的一些中国朋友会说他们对酒精过敏。
fullTextEN: Some of my Chinese friends say they are allergic to alcohol.

fullTextZH: 第二个办法就是喝别的。
fullTextEN: The second way is to drink something else.

fullTextZH: 你也可以说我以茶代酒，
fullTextEN: You can also say I substitute tea for alcohol,

fullTextZH: 以茶代酒的意思是我用这个茶代替酒，
fullTextEN: The meaning of substituting tea for alcohol is I use this tea instead of alcohol,
Find someone else to help you drink.

fullTextZH: 比如说你的男朋友或者你的女朋友很会喝酒，
fullTextEN: For example, if your boyfriend or girlfriend can drink a lot,

fullTextZH: 意思是他们可以喝很多酒，
fullTextEN: It means they can drink a lot of alcohol,

fullTextZH: 那你可以跟你的中国朋友说：嗯，
fullTextEN: Then you can say to your Chinese friend: Hmm,

fullTextZH: 我请我的男朋友帮我喝一杯，
fullTextEN: I ask my boyfriend to help me drink a glass,

fullTextZH: 你的中国朋友会同意吗？
如果这 3 个办法你都不喜欢，
fullTextEN: If you don't like these 3 methods,

fullTextZH: 这个你也可以用第 4 个办法，
fullTextEN: You can also use the fourth method,

fullTextZH: 就是很诚实地告诉别人：谢谢你的好意，
fullTextEN: Which is to honestly tell others: Thank you for your kindness,

fullTextZH: 可是我真的不能再喝了。
fullTextEN: But I really can't drink anymore.

fullTextZH: 那你的中国朋友会同意吗？

fullTextEN: You can give it a try.
Then you might ask me: Zhi Fei,
When others urge you to drink,
I would say: Am I pregnant?

fullTextZH: 我会告诉他们我不想喝，
fullTextEN: I will tell them I don't want to drink,

fullTextZH: 那他们会不会不高兴呢？
这就是为什么我没有很多朋友。
fullTextEN: That's why I don't have many friends.
